source: Assembly Final.step (Onshape, 2026-10-15): pivot, connector, base; socket.stl is the insert's socket part from the same file
frame: ball centre at the origin, z up the stand's axis; socket.stl in the insert frame: z = corenetic_socket_ee x (the cup axis, up when seated), x = -corenetic_socket_ee z (back towards the flange), y = corenetic_socket_ee y
profile_note: the stand below the ball, turned about z: neck, collar, connector, then the cone of the base
plate_note: the square foot on the table; its heading about z is not known, so it is checked as the disc that holds it (radius 50 * sqrt 2)
fingers_note: the two fingers in the STEP only show how the fingertips hold the insert, they are not the real fingertips: the gripper's own meshes (MJCF) are used instead
